title: Zeitai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rabbi Meir’s son-in-law, as stated in Yuchasin. Seder HaDorot writes: “I have not found it.” Hyman endorses Yuchasin: in Kohelet Rabbah 9:8, Zeitai says in Rabbi Meir’s name: “These recline and eat and drink, whereas those recline and do not eat.” Shabbat 153a attributes this saying to Rabbi Meir’s son-in-law in Rabbi Meir’s name. The Yalkut on Kohelet there explicitly names “Zeitai, Rabbi Meir’s son-in-law.”

notes.text: The consulted Kohelet Rabbah 9:8 names Zivtai in Rabbi Meir’s name; Shabbat 153a attributes the matching saying to Rabbi Meir’s unnamed son-in-law. Hyman’s identification and his reports of Yuchasin and the Yalkut remain attributed to him; those exact bibliographical witnesses have not been independently inspected here.
